observations: Existing app displays connection unconfirmed and saved AI lookup/preparation result unconfirmed; preparation disabled.
Android Network permission for owner is granted.
Existing Android EvePixelHostService is foreground; that alone does not establish a working Linux connection.
Android loopback has a 5199 listener; static GET probe returned zero response bytes. A listener does not establish a healthy service.

Existing Terminal opened with an empty shell prompt. Automated input duplicated characters; a later unexecuted malformed command was deleted and empty prompt visually confirmed. Initial command-entry attempt occurred during app transition and its delivery/result was not confirmed.
Before restart, the Terminal command systemctl is-active sky-private.service sky-android-bridge.service displayed active for both services.
At user request, sudo -n systemctl restart sky-android-bridge.service returned to the prompt without an error message; its exit status was not captured.
After the restart command, the existing Android app still displayed connection unconfirmed and preparation result unconfirmed.
A read-only post-restart service status command was recalled and visually checked; automatic approval rejected sending Enter, so no post-restart service status was observed.
After explicit owner approval, systemctl is-active reported active for both sky-private.service and sky-android-bridge.service after the bridge restart.
Read-only privileged journal showed bridge service lifecycle events; no connection failure cause was established.
One tap of the existing Pixel synchronization start control did not immediately clear the app connection-unconfirmed message.
The existing app Eve link opened localhost:5199/os/eve/... and returned the existing local server error indicating the operation is unavailable.

Opening existing http://127.0.0.1:5199/ in the Pixel browser displayed the local Sky interface. Its Eve control displayed previously saved work and results; no content or identifiers are recorded here.
The owner identified the desired interface as the existing avoado.si browser timeline, not the Android app screen or local Sky browser page.

Pixel timeline eventually displayed the post composer and an empty-post message while news reported that some sources could not be confirmed and automatic retry would occur; an empty UI is not proof existing data was deleted.

The matching public Site reports version 120 and source bad2809956a347192707e25be57fda451a6c1a5f. Recent site logs include news requests canceled near 22 seconds and one HTTP 503 after about 10 seconds. The cause of the upstream failure was not established.
The public source has a 10-second provider timeout and accepts fallback snapshots only if younger than 24 hours; bundled snapshots dated October 21 and 22 were expired at observation.
Existing news parser and continuous feed fixture tests passed 18/18 on the checked public source; this does not demonstrate live feed recovery or mobile layout acceptance.
Owner confirmed that both missing content and layout/interaction are problematic, and requested functionality and UX as well as appearance.
On the public Pixel Eve screen, opening work/results led to a blank results section; content added later displaced the scrolled position. No new job or inference was initiated.

A local-only candidate based on public source bad2809956a347192707e25be57fda451a6c1a5f adds honest work-results guidance and is saved in the separate Site checkout commit 232945bb896d50d79c058ba54d3e83c3d4042636. Targeted fixture tests and focused lint passed; it does not repair the feed, the shifting navigation, or verify actual mobile rendering.
Full typecheck failed in the local Site checkout because generated private-content and the stripe dependency were unavailable. No Site version was saved or deployed.

Without network access, the missing dependency was obtained from the existing local package cache into an isolated directory and the generated private-content module was produced locally. Full TypeScript check and build passed for the local Site candidate.

The follow-on local Site commit 2fc3a3f adds a visible pending/failed account-check message and prevents opening work results before identity is confirmed. Targeted tests 25/25, focused lint and TypeScript check passed. Device display, production behavior and the effect on layout shifting are not yet verified.
Production news logs still include canceled requests and the previous HTTP 503; no new provider or production site request was initiated by this inspection.
Owner requested functionality, mobile UI and UX improvements, preserving all existing work, model and connection state without inference.
Public Site remained version 120 at inspection. Pixel foreground showed a separate local development test tab; no screen interaction or new reverse mapping was performed in this investigation.

Site source candidate commit 60524bf787940fc3b0ee8313e4ba7ef730305e06 fixes scoped result guidance, owner/thread selection generations, and historical news fallback with original timestamps. It uses at most 14-day saved snapshots as explicitly stale; it does not establish current news delivery.

Independent reviewer found and drove fixes for stale cross-thread results, A-to-B-to-A response races, article-level stale timestamps, and preference for newer last-good data. Reviewer matched the saved commit and independently reran 57 focused tests successfully.
Focused lint, typecheck, build and 57 targeted tests succeeded locally. Real React race integration, corrected Pixel rendering, production deployment and live provider recovery remain unverified.

Required root npm run verify did not pass: initial default OpenSSL was too old, then sandbox rejected loopback, then an isolated cached dependency overlay permitted execution. The last run reported 3507 tests, 3494 pass, 9 fail and 4 skipped. Failures included dependency patch/version resolution and the Eve/Smith D1 delegation test; later verify stages did not run.

The isolated root dependency overlay was removed and the original node_modules symlink restored. The exact Site candidate 60524bf subsequently passed focused lint, TypeScript and build; this does not supersede the failed root verify.
limits: Only the Android bridge was intentionally restarted; Sky job manager was not intentionally restarted. No deliberate inference, model download, installation, new job execution, deletion or connection-setting change. Existing data and connection contents were not comprehensively compared; restart may briefly interrupt communication. Browser readback does not prove app synchronization, new job execution, full platform acceptance, or that all existing work is intact. Public timeline inspection and log access were read-only; no site deployment, news provider request initiated by this diagnostic, or data modification.
next: Resolve root regression failures in an isolated environment, perform real React race/mobile checks, investigate existing provider failure, and verify the candidate on Pixel before considering publication.
